question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct word is **"utmost".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Utmost** can be used to **highlight something's significance, seriousness, or method of execution.**
 
• We must proceed with the **utmost prudence** at **every turn**.
 
• So, the word **"utmost" **is appropriate to **put before caution.**

**Correct sentence:** Yet we must choose each step we take with utmost__ caution
